paper.title_en: Constraining superluminal Einstein-Æther gravity through gravitational memory
paper.abstract_en: Every emission of radiation in gravity also includes a nonwavelike component that leaves a permanent change in proper distances of the spacetime it travels through. This phenomenon is known as gravitational displacement memory. Building up on a recently developed computation framework that harnesses Isaacson's insights on a fundamental definition of gravitational waves, we compute the leading displacement memory formula in Einstein-Aether gravity. Our analysis represents the first direct calculation of gravitational memory in a metric theory with nontrivial asymptotic vector field value. We find that an emission of scalar and vector aether waves at a propagation speed greater than the speed of tensor radiation features unprotected causal directions with a priori unbound memory build-up. Based on the results and the existing constraint of luminally propagating tensor waves, we conjecture a stringent exclusion of the superluminal parameter space of Einstein-Aether gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究Einstein-Æther引力中的引力位移记忆效应，属于广义相对论基础理论范畴，涉及超光速参数空间的约束，理论深度较高，且首次在具有非平凡渐近矢量场值的度规理论中计算引力记忆，具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 通过引力记忆约束超光速Einstein-Æther引力
decision.abstract_zh: 引力中的每一次辐射发射也包含一个非波动分量，该分量会在其穿越的时空中留下固有距离的永久变化。这种现象被称为引力位移记忆。基于最近开发的一个计算框架，该框架利用了Isaacson关于引力波基本定义的洞见，我们计算了Einstein-Aether引力中的领头位移记忆公式。我们的分析代表了在具有非平凡渐近矢量场值的度规理论中对引力记忆的首次直接计算。我们发现，标量和矢量以太波以快于张量辐射传播速度的传播速度发射时，会表现出未受保护因果方向，并具有先验无界的记忆积累。基于这些结果以及对以光速传播的张量波的现有约束，我们推测Einstein-Aether引力的超光速参数空间被严格排除。
